updates.title: The agent tablet
items: Real estate agents get their own tablet, held in hand with its own typing animation. Its screen is live: everything you open and type shows up on the tablet you are holding.
Home screen with the weather in Los Santos, the calendar, the clock, the agency numbers and the agents on duty.
A real to-do list, saved and shared by the whole agency.
Appointments app: the boss plans meetings and briefings with a date, a time and a note, and every agent sees them.
Dynasty 8 app: the agency website with the interactive map and every property for sale. Agents create listings from a house on the map, a shell or a GTA interior.
Company app for the boss: employees, hiring, funds, commissions and unpaid invoices, with a map of everything sold.
SecuroServ lock: only agency members open the tablet, and only the boss gets into the company app.
Gallery for the agency photos and a Mail app with its own address.
The tablet speaks the same 41 languages as the script.

updates.title: First version
items: Decoration mode with objects by room, a search bar and a creator filter.
Change the color of a piece already placed, or resize it from 50% to 150%.
Cart and order, delivered in cardboard boxes next to you or at your front door. Pianos come in their own crate.
Pets room: dog beds, kennels, cages, bowls and pet decor.
Badges on catalogue cards show what a piece can do: Playable, Real flames, Smoke, Lights up, Wardrobe, Storage.
Your HUD hides while you decorate and comes back on every exit. Supported: jg-hud, 17mov, qs-interface, bablo-hud, wais-hud and mHud.
